runs.value: I lunched with Mrs. Halsey. Called on Glaenzer and sold Lotto picture. Ray went to Paris.

Saturday, Dec. 30, 1905
Karin always better. Jephson called.

runs.value: dined with Mrs. Ross and Miss Erichsen.

document.text: Bernhard had tea with Kondascheus, dined with Mrs. Ross and Miss Erichsen.
Sunday, Dec. 31, 1905

runs.value: Tea at Doughty House with Cooks and saw pictures. Dinner with the dear Michael Fields.
